summary: In the hall, Neo has been shot three times in the chest and falls onto the blue shag carpeting, his blood smearing down the wallpaper. Agent Smith stands over him, still aiming his weapon and taking no chances, then orders someone off-screen to "Check him."

what_changes.before: standing and trying to escape through the door
what_changes.after: shot three times in the chest and fallen to the floor
what_changes.evidence: Three holes in his chest, Neo falls to the blue shag carpeting, blood smearing down the wallpaper.

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith shoots Neo down in the hall and orders him checked.

uncertain: Whether Agent Smith's order "Check him" is obeyed within this scene.
Whether Neo is actually dead or merely incapacitated.
